cues.en: Instructor: In this unsupervised learning challenge, you are going to have the opportunity to explore the effects of noise
cues.zh: 講師：這個無監督學習挑戰，讓你有機會探索雜訊

cues.en: and averaging on the resulting correlation matrix.
cues.zh: 與平均，對最後相關矩陣的影響。

cues.en: So here's what you want to do.
cues.zh: 要做的事情如下。

cues.en: Go back to the code where we create the multi-variate data.
cues.zh: 回到建立多變量資料的程式碼。

cues.en: Now remember that this is done in two lines.
cues.zh: 記得，這是用兩行完成的。

cues.en: So in MatLab, it's two lines of code.
cues.zh: MATLAB 中是兩行程式碼。

cues.en: In Python, this one line of code is expanded into a small for loop, but that doesn't matter.
cues.zh: Python 中，其中一行展開成一個小 for 迴圈，但沒有關係。

cues.en: The point is that we create noiseless data first, and then we add random noise to it.
cues.zh: 重點是先建立無雜訊資料，再加入隨機雜訊。

cues.en: So what you want to do in this challenge is create 20 of these data sets, so 20 different data sets,
cues.zh: 這次挑戰要你建立 20 份這樣的資料集，也就是 20 份不同資料集，

cues.en: and they're all the same except for the noise.
cues.zh: 除了雜訊之外，全都相同。

cues.en: So the noise should be different on every repetition, every instance of the 20 data sets and this part should be the same.
cues.zh: 每次重複、20 份資料的每一份實例，雜訊都要不同，而這一部分保持相同。

cues.en: So that's step one is to create 20 of these data matrices that all have the same underlying characteristics, but different sets of noise.
cues.zh: 第一步，就是建立 20 個底層特性完全相同，但雜訊各不相同的資料矩陣。

cues.en: And then step two is to compute a correlation matrix between them in two ways.
cues.zh: 第二步，用兩種方法計算它們的相關矩陣。

cues.en: First, you want to average all of those data sets together, and then compute one correlation matrix.
cues.zh: 首先，把所有資料集平均，再計算一個相關矩陣。

cues.en: So you're gonna get 20 of these things with 20 different random noise instances, and then you average them all together to get one average dataset and then you compute the correlation matrix.
cues.zh: 你會有 20 份帶著不同隨機雜訊的資料，把它們全部平均，得到一份平均資料集，再計算相關矩陣。

cues.en: And a second way you can do it is by creating 20 different correlation matrices based on each instance of the data.
cues.zh: 第二種方法，是對每份資料分別建立相關矩陣，共建立 20 個不同的相關矩陣。

cues.en: So you have 20 data matrices, that's gonna give you 20 correlation matrices, and then you average together those 20 correlation matrices, and then you can compare these two correlation matrices
cues.zh: 20 個資料矩陣會得到 20 個相關矩陣，再把這 20 個相關矩陣平均，就能比較這兩個

cues.en: that you've created.
cues.zh: 以不同方式建立的相關矩陣。

cues.en: So one correlation matrix by averaging the data and then computing the correlation and one correlation matrix from computing independent correlation matrices,
cues.zh: 一個是先平均資料，再計算相關；另一個是先計算各自的相關矩陣，

cues.en: and then averaging together all of those correlation matrices.
cues.zh: 再把所有相關矩陣平均。

cues.en: So once you've done that, once you've set up the code to create these two different correlation matrices based on averaging the data versus averaging the correlation matrices,
cues.zh: 等你寫好程式，以平均資料及平均相關矩陣這兩種方式，建立兩個不同的相關矩陣之後，

cues.en: then what you can do is explore the effects of noise on those two results and see whether noise affects the data more when you average the data together
cues.zh: 就可以探索雜訊對兩個結果的影響，看看雜訊對先平均資料的結果影響較大，

cues.en: or more when you average the correlation matrices together.
cues.zh: 還是對先計算、再平均相關矩陣的結果影響較大。

cues.en: So you can try a little bit of noise, you can try a lot of noise.
cues.zh: 可以試少量雜訊，也可以試大量雜訊。

cues.en: In this case, it's still being multiplied by 10, but that's just from the end of the previous video.
cues.zh: 這裡仍然乘以 10，只是沿用上一支影片結尾的設定。

cues.en: So you can try multiplying by small numbers, multiplying by large numbers, and just kind of exploring the relationship between noise and different ways of averaging data
cues.zh: 你可以乘上較小或較大的數字，探索雜訊與不同平均資料方式，

cues.en: and correlation matrices.
cues.zh: 以及平均相關矩陣方式之間的關係。
